digest.component_or_area: environment variable registry and config-ownership gate
propositions: KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table contains four ghost rows (_rebar_env, _env_int, _str_pref, _int_pref) with no corresponding def/async def definitions under src/rebar, violating the module's stated invariant 'Signatures verified against the current tree'

Missing table-to-tree validation allows stale rows to persist undetected, creating holes in config-ownership gate enforcement where unmapped helper names bypass seam validation by dict key match alone
Ghost row for _str_pref coincided with silent deletion of REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE from docs/env-vars.md, demonstrating the diagnostic value of row staleness detection at rename time
The held-out oracle test for check_config_ownership selects its fixture by dict insertion order (targeting position 0) and is load-bearing on the ghost _rebar_env, failing RED when ghosts are removed

A root-independent structural validation must gate stale rows against DEFAULT_SCAN_ROOT rather than the caller's arbitrary root, preventing false positives against synthetic test trees where 13 of 13 rows appear stale
